weapon.d: At start of turn, restores 10 HP. At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+5 to unit during combat.

assist.d: Grants Res+4 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Spd/Res+3 to target ally for 1 turn.
Grants Spd/Res+6 to target ally for 1 turn.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Spd+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Spd+7, but after combat, if unit attacked, deals 5 damage to unit.

b.d: Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-2 on foe, neutralizes foe's bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.), and disables foe's skills that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res" during combat.
